proposed_widenings.name: set_size
proposed_widenings.justification: Large Form's core effect is a temporary self-size change to Large. Existing atoms can modify speed, checks, and ability scores, but none can represent becoming Large without overclaiming with polymorph-style replacement.
proposed_widenings.evidence: you can change your size to Large as a Bonus Action

proposed_widenings.name: species_trait_level_gate
proposed_widenings.justification: The unit is a species trait that only unlocks starting at character level 5. SpeciesTraitRecord has no acquired-at level field or mechanics-side eligibility gate, so the authored surface cannot represent when the trait becomes available.

proposed_widenings.name: duration_end_manual_no_action
proposed_widenings.justification: The effect has a timed duration that can also end early at the user's option with no action. Current activated-ability duration supports timed windows but not an explicit owner-driven early end.
proposed_widenings.evidence: This transformation lasts for 10 minutes or until you end it (no action required).

notes: Did not author content/species_goliath_large_form.dhall because omitting the temporary Large size change would produce a misleading trace. The secondary riders (+10 Speed, Advantage on Strength checks) fit existing atoms, but the primary mechanic does not.
